purpose: Recover the bundled HP1/HP2 payloads from the published 0.4.2 APK for future local builds
extractedTo: game-data/hp1 and game-data/hp2 (not committed; copyrighted game files)
method: Stream-extracted every entry under each prefix from the 0.4.2 APK zip, excluding the .stamp marker.
Re-ran release_checks.hp1_inventory / hp2_inventory against the extracted directories.
Recomputed the stamp as SHA-256 over each path plus its file SHA-256 in inventory order.
result: Computed stamps match the .stamp entries stored in the APK for both payloads; required-file counts and byte totals match the published build verification.
limits: No emulator or device run was performed on the extracted data.
The extracted directory is outside version control and must not be published.
